title: Open Trestle model-review corpus human adjudication v1
description: Externally asserted, source-first human review of the exact pending labels of one model-review corpus, with one decision per case in corpus order. The importer pins the record by the SHA-256 of its exact bytes and checks every case identifier, order and label digest against the corpus. The record does not authenticate a reviewer, prove independence or review order, change a label, set a threshold or approve a release.

corpus_identity.description: The corpus_identity of the reviewed corpus manifest.

manifest_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the reviewed manifest.json bytes.

reviewer_identifier.description: The reviewer's own identifier, distinct from the declared fixture author. It is not authenticated.

fixture_author_identifier.description: The fixture author every version 1 label set declares.

review_date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD; the importer also refuses a day the month does not have.

source_first.description: The reviewer read each case's base and head trees and diff before its labels.

prior_run_output_exposure.description: The reviewer declares no exposure to any model run output for this corpus before completing the review. Disclosed exposure has no admissible value.

cases.description: Exactly one row for every corpus case, in manifest case order.

oneOf.description: The case's existing labels are confirmed as they stand.
The labels need a revision or the case is rejected. The case is excluded from adjudicated scoring and reported with this reason; a revised label belongs in a new corpus version.
